text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket has been working hard on weight-loss training
for her diet, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just gaining a little weight...
and I can barely run anymore... ughhh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I've... already lost the power
I had to run at full throttle back thennn~~~...!!
choice_data_list: Then just take it back with everything you've got!
Then let's take it back with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah...?!
I'll give it everything I've got...!! And take it back...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
U... Uwooooohhhh!!!
This much weight is nothin' to meee...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Compared to getting back to full power...!!!
This feels like nothing at aaaaalll!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Come on... me!!!
Don't you give up!!! Come on, meeeeeee!!!"

After running non-stop without looking back,
Winning Ticket successfully lost the weight...!
